title: 就业报告强劲：却无关就业？，贝莱德通胀才是关键
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: What's your reaction to that job report from 20 minutes ago? Yeah, I mean, I think you guys have covered it well. It was a strong report across the board.
segments.zh: 你对20分钟前发布的就业报告有何看法？我认为你们已经报道得很全面了。这是一份全面强劲的报告。

segments.en: And, you know, the jobs report really only had the chance to sort of decrease the likelihood if it was exceptionally weak. This is as you guys have discussed. This is much more about next week
segments.zh: 而且，正如你们所讨论的，这份就业报告只有在异常疲软的情况下才可能降低加息可能性。这更多关乎下周和通胀。

segments.en: and much more about inflation. Yeah, the one thing I would sort of point out is that the point three.
segments.zh: 是的，我想指出的一点是0.3%的增幅。

segments.en: Yeah, that's good and it's a rebound. But if you look at the year-over-year figures, you know, the labor market isn't really contributing to the inflation story. A lot of discussion
segments.zh: 是的，这很好，是反弹。但看同比数据，劳动力市场并未真正推动通胀。很多讨论关注薪资通胀是否传导。

segments.en: about whether or not wage inflation is passing through and whether that's the story.
segments.zh: 但这不是主要因素。所以正如丽莎所说，这确认了我们对劳动力市场的认知，并将焦点转回通胀。

segments.en: But it's not really the story. And so I think as Lisa just said, this kind of confirms what we've known about the labor market and it puts the focus and the onus back on the inflation. And so it's
segments.zh: 因此，真正决定美联储是否在9月加息的是通胀是否上升或下降得不够快。我认为这是今日就业报告的关键信息。

segments.en: really about inflation going up or not going down fast enough as to whether or not the Fed hikes in the September meeting. And I think that's the takeaway from the labor market report today.
segments.zh: 杰夫，我们能否在劳动力市场上多停留片刻，并基于你所说的进一步探讨？

segments.en: Can we just sit on the labor market for an extra beat, Jeff, and just build on what you said?
segments.zh: 因为我认为这很重要。我们经历了某种负供给冲击，这很重要。这就是为什么人们谈论较低的盈亏平衡率。

segments.en: Because I do think it's important. We have had a form of negative supply shot go through the labor market. That's important. That's why people are talking about a lower break even rate.
segments.zh: 我们国家名义GDP相当高，但并未产生大规模薪资增长，那种你可能联想到这些力量的数据。

segments.en: We're experiencing pretty hot nominal GDP in this country. Yet we're not generating wage growth, big wage growth, the kind of numbers you might associate with those kind of forces, Jeff.
segments.zh: 我们正经历相当高的名义GDP增长，但并未带来大幅工资增长，那种通常与这些因素相关的数字，Jeff。
